## Triage: first grade, `priority:p3` · `domain:cli` · `area:devpath` · `bug` · `pm:blocked` on PR #22381 (`finding` removed)

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-09T03:56Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (the dev-mode docs mirror) ⇒ `domain:cli`.

- **Why p3:** a config boot (`os serve <config> --dev`) of a multi-package composed project serves none of its flat `src/docs` pages, and nothing warns. `os dev` boots a compiled artifact, so it is unaffected.
- **Direction:** the card's own. The config boot places the flat docs through `placeCollectedDocs`, which landed with PR #22403 (merged), on the package whose id is the stack's `manifest.id`.
  - ⛔ No second placement rule in `serve.ts`.
  - The stale `why` row in `normalized-call-sites.test.ts` rides the same PR.
- **Pins:** the flat docs are served under the owning package. Control: a single-package config boot is unchanged.
- **Blocked on PR #22381** (#22301 stage 2), which holds `serve.ts`:

Blocked-by: #22381

## Unlock: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. PR #22381 merged

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-09T14:01Z. Unlock scan. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Thread-read: 6073952906

- PR #22381 (#22301 item 1 stage 2) merged as `97610a5339`. It held `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, which this card's fix edits.
- The grade and direction in `6073952906` stand. The claimant re-reads `serve.ts` on current `main` before writing, because stage 2 reshaped what `serve` composes.
- At this read, no open PR touches `serve.ts`.

Claim: PM loop round 3
Session: `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22405-serve-flat-docs-owner`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22405`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#1`
File surface (read at `origin/main` `d2e7d6c6f`):
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`: only the dev-mode docs mirror, the `!useArtifactFallback` collection under the `#18431` comment. It places the flat `src/docs` set through `placeCollectedDocs`.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`: read-only by default. An edit is allowed only if the serve call cannot hand `placeCollectedDocs` its input as it stands. Such an edit must not change placement, and the report names it. ⛔ No second placement rule in either file.
- `packages/cli/test/normalized-call-sites.test.ts`: only the `commands/serve.ts :: config.docs` row's `why`.
- A config-boot pin beside `serve.ts` or `collect-docs.ts`, in whichever existing suite takes it.
- `.changeset/22405-*.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch).

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. It is not mechanical: the judgment is where a config boot's packages are registered. `dispatch-gates --tier` prints "no path-derived mandate".
Clause-②: no
The fix moves where an already-collected flat doc is registered, so that a config boot serves what `os build` already serves (PR #22403). No accepted input, key or export changes.
Responsibility: the dev-mode docs mirror in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` puts a multi-package config's flat `src/docs` set on the top level, which the per-package boot never registers, and nothing warns | `placeCollectedDocs` in `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`, which `os build` uses since PR #22403. `os dev` boots that artifact and is unaffected | whoever runs `os serve <config> --dev` on a multi-package `composeStacks` project with a flat `src/docs/` (measured once by #22190's dev on PR #22403's build)
Thread-read: 6082460379
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `serve.ts`, `collect-docs.ts` or `normalized-call-sites.test.ts` (REST file lists of all 9 open PRs, read in this act). The last change to `serve.ts` on `main` is `97610a533` (PR #22381), which unlocked this card. In flight in this lane: #22432 (`area:access`: `runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`, the authz ledgers and the Console pin), which is disjoint.
Fold-or-serial (#22405, #22410 and #22420 all edit `serve.ts`): **serial; this card is the chain head.** Folding fails gate ① of five: the three are different defect shapes with different fixes (flat-doc placement here, print order across the IPC in #22410, an HTTP answer for a refused Console mount in #22420). #22410 is next, then #22420. Each merges `main` after its predecessor lands.

Direction: triage `6073952906`, standing per the unlock `6082460379`. Review of record: the seat's ACCEPT and CI. No contract-tier review is owed (by face).
